docs/extensions.md:22:      github:cv/pit#v0.36.5          # pit's typescript tool
docs/extensions.md:76:      github:cv/pit#v0.36.5   # pit's typescript tool (pit/durable)
docs/extensions.md:109:| `images` | An image processor, `createNodePhotonImages()` of pi-durable. It resizes and converts images to the limits of the model, for example for pit's `workspace.viewImage` (pit 0.36.2 and later) |
docs/extensions.md:115:A tool can say how the [workflow log](how-it-works.md#the-workflow-log) shows its calls. Give the tool an optional `present` field. pi-durable does not use it, so other hosts ignore it. pit's `typescript` tool has one (pit 0.36.5 and later): the log shows the label of each program, its code, the functions it uses, and its result as text:
docs/extensions.md:153:pit 0.36.0 and later hide the coding tools from the model themselves. The model gets only pit's `typescript` tool without these inputs, and pit's programs use `workspace.*` and `shell.*` instead of the coding tools (see [Tools the model sees](https://github.com/cv/pit/blob/main/docs/durable.md#tools-the-model-sees) in pit). With an earlier pit, hide the coding tools with `model_tools_hidden`. Its programs can then still call them through `tools.*`:

docs/workflows.md:128:      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
src/thread.test.ts:113:/** pit 0.36: its `typescript` tool, with the coding tools hidden from the model. */
